title: feat: dark mode toggle for the settings page
body:
## What
Adds a dark mode toggle to the settings page. Theme preference persists to localStorage and falls back to the OS `prefers-color-scheme`.

## Why
Top request in the last user survey (#311).

## How
- New `ThemeToggle` component + `useTheme` hook
- CSS variables swapped via a `data-theme` attribute on `<html>`

## Screenshots
_(light/dark side-by-side in the PR)_

comments.body: Love this. Does it respect the OS setting on first load?
Yep — falls back to prefers-color-scheme when nothing is stored.

reviews.body: A couple of small things, otherwise LGTM.
